_comment: Source of truth for the Software section of research.html. Edit this file, then run `python3 build_research.py`. While the list is empty the section renders the placeholder below instead of cards. Fields per entry: name, description and url (repo link) are required; role (your involvement, e.g. "Main developer", "Contributor", "Maintainer"), logo (a file in images/software/), language, license, and paper_title + paper_url are optional -- leave a field as "" and it is simply not rendered.
placeholder: Code accompanying my papers is linked from each publication above. A curated list of tools and packages will appear here.

software.name: CONDUCTOR
software.description: An LLM-orchestrated digital twin for uncertainty-aware power-system operations. A FastAPI backend exposes security assessment, N-1 contingency, probabilistic risk, robust corrective dispatch and flexibility studies as tools; a natural-language agent drives them from a chat interface, running on a hosted model or fully locally so that no grid data leaves the machine.
